thread:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock acceptance criteria + launch plan for the gatekeeper rollout (VPC/on-prem). Customers flagged IP-preserve, offline installer, and KMS integration as blockers.
sam: TL;DR: we can ship opt-in operator shim + optional relay for NAT'd installs. Need to confirm rollback time.
mike: For IP-preserve we need controller that preserves host egress IP or transparent SNAT bypass; that's ops work.
lina: Customer asks: zero config peering, preserve source IP, and ability to opt into private KMS. They're not ok with app-layer proxies.
rahul: field note: three customers already blocked on this. If we don't ship a low-friction lane they will delay.
anya: Proposed launch gates:
- minimal: operator shim + doc for egress IP mapping
- canary: 5 customers, monitoring + SLA for install success
- GA: rollouts + upgrade instructions + rollback playbook
sam: SLOs we need to hit: install success >=95, post-upgrade correctness >=98, rollback <15m for 90% of failures.
mike: Also need ipam checklist and egress pinning guide. Who owns? ops.
lina: test matrix: onprem airgapped, VPC with NAT, VPC with dedicated egress, hybrid.
rahul: also include network validation script we can provide to customers pre-onboard.
sam: POC command for validation:
```
# run on customer node
curl -s http://169.254.169.254/check-ip || echo "no metadata"
ip route get 8.8.8.8
```
anya: Deployment options: 1) operator shim (recommended), 2) relay + NAT (fallback), 3) full BGP peering (long lead).
mike: Risk log: BGP adds ops burden; relay has perf hit; shim is simplest but may not satisfy all customers.
lina: Rollout playbook snippet for canary:
- schedule maintenance window
- run validation script (rahul's)
- install operator in daemonset mode
- verify egress/preserve-ip
- monitor for 30m
rahul: Who volunteers to own docs and runbooks? can take docs + validation script.
sam: Eng tasks for this sprint:
- operator shim v0.1 (sam)
- egress mapping library (sam + mike)
- validation script + docs (rahul)
- installer tweak for airgap (anya)
anya: timeline: sprint0 (2 weeks): shim + docs + 1 internal customer test. sprint1: canaries with 5 customers.
mike: Performance targets: no >10% token latency regression; we should measure tail p95/p99.
anya: Final ask: product signoff on launch gates and owners. @sam @mike @rahul confirm by EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: Deployment window available: 2024-08-12 02:00 UTC (automated booking)
sam: Confirmed, will start shim PR today.
mike: I'll draft ipam checklist and egress guide.
rahul: I'll prepare validation script and schedule first field pilot.
anya: Thanks — I'll assemble final checklist and post to launch-docs channel.
